proposal:
# Re-rank proposal 5 (new card 216 and unranked card 215)

- Led by: product manager seat, fresh context (pm-rerank-5). Claude seat because probes at 08:21 UTC show Codex, Copilot, Grok and agy without usable quota (.mob/records/probes/2026-10-30.jsonl, commit a5be583).
- Before list (Ready): 214, 213, 209, 210, 208, 211, 212, 206, 207. Card 215 is filed and not yet ranked; card 216 is new.
- Proposed after list:
  1. 214 (F-056 corrective; its task force is being decided by D156)
  2. 213 (paused after Done check 2; resumes when 214 is Done)
  3. 209 (MD-001)
  4. 210 (MD-003)
  5. 208 (MD-002, F-008)
  6. 211 (MD-010, records only, may run in parallel)
  7. 216 (mob-defaults templates carry the six pending rulings; docs and templates only, no dependency; enables 212 and 215)
  8. 212 (re-rank for every mob, runner part only; depends on 208; enforces text 216 already states)
  9. 215 (adjustment_reviews record fields and check, D155; depends on 208; matches the template 216 already states)
  10. 206 (F-008, findings mirror)
  11. 207 (F-008 history rules; depends on 206)
- Rationale (one line): 216 and 215 are not corrective for any open finding, so they cannot start while MD-001, MD-002, MD-003, MD-010 and F-056 block and placing them higher buys no earlier start; 216 goes first of the mob-defaults cards because it has no dependency and enables 212 and 215, which then follow in dependency order.

## What changed and why
- 216 is new and enters at position 7, directly after the last MD corrective card (211) and before 212. The product owner asked for it to be brought through the re-rank like any card. It has no dependency and is a thin docs-and-template slice, so it is the cheapest card in the mob-defaults group, and it must land before 212 and 215 so that their runner and record parts enforce text the template already states. Ranking it above 209, 210, 208 or 211 would not start it sooner: it is not corrective, and the facilitator gate refuses a non-corrective start while findings block. It would only make the order say something the gate will not honour.
- 215 is new to the ranking and enters at position 9, after 212. It depends on 208 (it adds record fields to the retro step 208 wires), so it cannot precede 208. Behind 216 it narrows to its runner and record parts. It sits after 212 because 212 closes the older, audited gap (F4: a re-rank without a note) while 215 adds a new check, and 215 enables 205 only.
- 212 moves from 7 to 8 (one place down, behind 216). 206 and 207 move down two places; their relative order, dependency and F-008 purpose are unchanged.
- 214, 213, 209, 210, 208 and 211 keep their order. 216 and 215 get card-text windows narrowing 212 and 215 (their template Done checks move to 216), and 216's task force is declared at ready by objection window with every declared role polled (F-054).

## Evidence considered
- Card 216 (gh issue view 216): Draft, Contract, no dependency, three Done checks (loop rulings, experiments, auditor checks P1 and R1), enables 212 and 215, not corrective for an open finding, non-author review and auditor verification against each of the six rulings.
- Card 215 (gh issue view 215): Draft, Contract, depends on 208, not corrective, enables 205; its template Done check moves to 216.
- Audit ledger (.mob/audits/last.json): open FAILs MD-001, MD-002, MD-003, MD-010 and F-056 (audit 24). The facilitator gate means a non-corrective card cannot start while findings block.
- Re-rank note 4: current order 214, 213, 209, 210, 208, 211, 212, 206, 207.
- Probes 08:21 UTC: only Claude usable.

## Neither a one-way door nor a standing-rule change
The Rank field is edited in git and can be reversed by the next re-rank. It changes no agreement, D-record, checker or published claim, and no data. It applies the existing stop-the-line rules and D148 as amended by D153 (loop-boundary re-rank decided by objection window with a committed note, P1).

## Window rule: every declared role polled (F-054)
Every declared role is polled in this window: the card task-force roles architect, QA engineer, backend developer, independent reviewer (audit lens), delivery lead, and product manager (signoff). The product manager (ready) is the proposer and is not polled. The facilitator, the Decider and the external auditor are never seats and are not polled as roles. An empty or silent reply is re-polled and recorded as an attempt, not counted as no objection.

NO OBJECTION

Yes. The ordering is sound: it puts 216 before 212 and 215, so their checker and record parts enforce text that already exists. It also honours the dependencies on 208 and the corrective-first gate. That keeps the design minimal and the checks enforceable without false positives.
